findings.text: No test covers the new `LivePage.meta_stream` / `on_meta` (public/live/LivePage.test.mjs untouched in the diff); a lean case (stream a fake page.jsonl, append `{"tab": true}`, assert the listener fires and `meta.tab` is true) would pin the behaviour that was only proved by the browser probe (law 12).

The task folder has no outcome or evidence record (no complete/outcome file, no link from the session record to `live-r16`); it holds only requirements.md, shots/ and the diff, so a fresh agent cannot see that the work landed or which commit holds it (law 10, "Work as a task").

shots/tabs-after.txt line 5 ("new folder + file line") shows the h1 reading "Beta" again after line 4 showed "Beta Renamed"; probably the probe reset beta's file, but nothing in the file says so, and a reader may take it for a regression in `meta_stream`'s reset path (LivePage.js `jsonl.reset`).

`on_meta` listeners are removed only when they are next heard after their view disconnects (LivePage.js, `heard`); a page that is left and never has another meta write keeps its closure in `meta_heard`. Harmless in size, but the comment "Lets go the first time it is heard" is the only place this is stated.

Ask (a) needed no change and (b) is met by a small, single-mechanism fix (one streamed reader per url, shared listeners); the "watch only shown urls" alternative is recorded in requirements.md, so no simpler option is missed. public/live/readme.md is updated in the Both-stream paragraph, and nothing new is unindexed.

answer.reply: fixed: meta_fold factored out of meta_stream; LivePage.test check 14 covers meta_fold (class, tab, title, a card line that says nothing) and on_meta (calls back only for its urls; lets go after the view left). 44 passed (2a5a36ee1).
noted: the outcome and evidence are written by close_task at landing, the same as live-r12 to r15; the voice-app task is closed with the merge commit.
fixed: the probe writes beta's title back to "Beta" after the rename line, so line 5 shows Beta; requirements.md now says so.
noted: a left view's closure stays until the next meta line from any watched page; a few closures per page visit, gone at the first change. Accepted.

declined: the outcome and evidence line is written by close_task right after the merge (as in live-r12 to r15), so it can name the merge commit; writing it before the merge would claim a landing that has not happened.

complete.outcome: A sub-page's own file now streams into /live/'s tab row, link cards and Pages list (its {"tab": true} or a new title needed a reload); item files already streamed; /live/design/'s strip is back in the column.
